subject: [PATCH v4 06/21] btrfs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the Btrfs direct I/O operations to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using a macro that wraps the iomap_iter_next helper. This change does not introduce any functional changes and only updates the internal implementation of the Btrfs direct I/O code. The conversion is done by replacing the existing iomap_begin and iomap_end callbacks with the new iomap_next callback.
